name: Mahanarayan Classical Medicated Massage Oil
subtitle: Classical Formula with 30+ Wildcrafted Herbs (Bhaishajya Ratnavali)
shortDescription: Authentic 72-hour slow-simmered brass cauldron Taila with Bilva, Ashwagandha, and Shatavari in organic black sesame oil for joint mobility, muscle soothing, and Vata balancing.
description: Mahanarayan Taila is a revered classical Ayurvedic medicated oil crafted according to the ancient Bhaishajya Ratnavali text. Prepared through authentic 72-hour continuous simmering in heavy brass cauldrons, this formulation blends 30+ potent wildcrafted herbs including Bilva, Ashwagandha, Bala, Shatavari, and Dashamula into pure cold-pressed black sesame oil. Ideal for traditional Abhyanga, sports rejuvenation, and clinical Panchkarma therapies.
benefits: Classical Abhyanga formula for soothing joint tightness and deep tissue stiffness
Calms aggravated Vata dosha and nourishes peripheral neuromuscular pathways
72-hour slow brass cauldron extraction ensures complete lipid-soluble herb infusion
100% natural cold-pressed virgin black sesame oil carrier base

specifications.Simmering Process: 72-Hour Continuous Paka in Traditional Brass Cauldrons
specifications.Safety Standards: Heavy Metal Tested (< 0.1 ppm), Free from synthetic mineral oils and fragrances

name: Ksheerabala 101 Classical Medicated Taila
subtitle: 101-Times Potentiated with Bala Decoction & Organic Cow Milk (Sahasrayogam)
shortDescription: Ultra-potent 101x repeated Avarti formulation prepared with Bala root decoction, pure A2 milk, and sesame oil for neuromuscular rejuvenation, Shirodhara, and Nasya.
description: Ksheerabala 101 Taila represents the pinnacle of classical Ayurvedic pharmaceutical potentiation (Avarti). Prepared according to the sacred Sahasrayogam text, the Bala root decoction and organic cow milk are reduced and infused into sesame oil 101 consecutive times. This intensive 6-month process concentrates bio-active phytosterols for profound nervous system nourishment, Shirodhara therapy, and restorative Panchkarma protocols.
benefits: 101-fold Avarti concentration delivers exceptional neuromuscular bio-availability
Essential choice for clinical Shirodhara, Nasya karma, and Matra Basti
Deeply calms sensory overstimulation, mental restlessness, and sleep disturbances
Processed strictly with A2 cow milk and wild-harvested Bala roots

name: Kumkumadi Saffron Classical Radiance Tailam
subtitle: Kashmiri Mongra Saffron, Lotus Pollen & Red Sandalwood Elixir (Ashtanga Hridaya)
shortDescription: Prestigious 26-herb Ayurvedic facial elixir crafted with pure Grade-A Kashmiri saffron strands, sandalwood, and goat milk for luminous skin texture, complexion tone, and cellular nourishment.
description: Kumkumadi Tailam is Ayurveda's most revered beauty nectar, meticulously prepared according to Ashtanga Hridaya. Infused with pristine Kashmiri Mongra saffron stigma, Chandana, Manjistha, and Yashtimadhu in a nourishing sesame and goat milk lipid matrix. Each drop enhances facial luminosity, restores natural skin barrier hydration, and diminishes the appearance of uneven pigmentation.
benefits: Pure Kashmiri Mongra Saffron promotes natural, radiant facial luminosity
Reduces hyperpigmentation, dark circles, and signs of environmental fatigue
Enriched with 26 authentic classical botanicals simmered in organic goat milk
100% free of artificial fragrances, chemical preservatives, and synthetic dyes

name: Organic Triphala Classical Micro-Milled Churna
subtitle: Equal Ratio Haritaki, Bibhitaki & Amalaki (Charaka Samhita Sutrasthana)
shortDescription: Traditional equal-part blend of wildcrafted Haritaki, Bibhitaki, and Amalaki micro-milled to 120-mesh fineness for optimal digestive harmony, internal cleansing, and antioxidant vitality.
description: Triphala Churna is Ayurveda's cornerstone Rasayana formulation described in Charaka Samhita. Sourced from pristine wild deciduous forests, our Haritaki, Bibhitaki, and organic Amalaki are sun-dried and micro-milled under strict temperature control to preserve heat-sensitive bio-tannins and natural Vitamin C. It gently cleanses the gastrointestinal tract, supports healthy peristalsis, and tones ocular vitality.
benefits: Gentle daily detoxification without creating dependency or electrolyte imbalance
Rich in natural stable Vitamin C, bio-flavonoids, and polyphenolic tannins
Micro-milled to 120-mesh fineness for rapid dissolution in warm water
100% Certified Organic wild-foraged forest harvest

subtitle: Sacred Ten Roots Formula for Decoctions, Basti & Swedana (Sahasrayogam)
shortDescription: Traditional equal combination of five Brihat Panchamula tree roots and five Laghu Panchamula shrub roots, coarse-ground for concentrated decoction preparation in Vata disorders.

Correct botanical ratio of 5 Brihat and 5 Laghu roots strictly maintained
100% naturally shade-dried and clean-sorted
